calibration.allowed: Independent material, contact, membrane, geometry, pressure-transfer and fixture tests; S02 feasibility pilot is for operating-domain and sensor feasibility, not held-out bending fitting.

numerical_verification.allowed: Mesh/time/contact-regularization convergence, constitutive update benchmarks, equilibrium and energy checks; no fitting to experimental bending.

held_out_validation.reserved: Prespecified pressure-curvature-temperature bending paths/specimens after model/code/parameters/metrics/tolerances are locked.
held_out_validation.use: One forward evaluation under S06/S07; no physical or numerical parameter adjustment to improve fit.

parameters.independent_source_or_check: single-wire cyclic tension/compression/bending as needed across temperature and rate
single-wire thermomechanical onset/finish and unloading tests

parameters.parameter_group: temperature dependence, latent heat and heat transfer if needed
parameters.independent_source_or_check: single-wire rate/temperature tests and S02 pilot
direct shear/crossed-wire or pull-out under independently measured normal load, cycle and temperature
independent section compression, membrane inflation and pull-out/contact-pressure proxy with uncertainty
as-built imaging or equivalent geometric measurement
mesh/contact convergence, penetration/slip sensitivity and energy checks only
numerical convergence and benchmark checks only

freeze_rule: S05 must version and timestamp code, physical parameter estimates/covariance or ranges, numerical convergence settings, predictions, held-out paths, metrics and tolerances before S06 data acquisition/unblinding.
failure_rule: A fit/refit using held-out data fails that locked model version and requires a new version and a new untouched validation set.
compensation_checks: membrane/fixture compliance versus bundle bending stiffness
contact regularization versus physical traction predictions
